response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), s AS (SELECT arcref, qc_count, CAST(qc_count AS REAL) / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS share FROM c) SELECT arcref, qc_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS deviation FROM s ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST, arcref LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Only projects that appear in scanqc are included (no zero-count projects from the projects table), so the average share is taken over those projects, which equals 1 divided by their number.
Ties at the 10th place are cut arbitrarily; arcref is used as a deterministic tie-breaker, and the share is computed as a floating-point division.
